items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: I remember Dad James. I don't know if you can think about him. I don't remember. He was a good singer.

ctx.x: Did they have any other acts, like famous singers or artists that would come in from our town, if you can remember at that time?
I can remember some. I remember Dad James. I don't know if you can think about him. I don't remember. He was a good singer. And Luke Cannon.

We collect records. Of course, I've always collected records for 20 or 30 years now. And I have a lot of the old time records, too. The period of Bessie Smith and Ma Rainey and everyone of that kind. Oh, yes. So unless a person recorded, I wouldn't know a lot of those names.
